messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PD alert fired PD-12345 — gpu-west2a pool experiencing sustained GPU memory pressure (avg free < 200MB for 2m). Auto-suppression: disabled. https://pagerduty.example/PD-12345
PagerDuty: PD-12345 created by metric-alerter. Severity: P1. Trigger: nvml_alloc_fail_rate > 4% over 2m.
alex (oncall): Acking PD-12345 and jumping in. I'm onstandby at the terminal.
PagerDuty: alex (oncall) acknowledged PD-12345.
mike (runtime): seeing a bunch of this in the logs: `E nvml: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` across containe rs. NVML shows fragmentation spikes on gpunode-17.
raman (eng): Confirmed. kvcache evictions up, per-pool prefet ch rates spiking. Starting quick drain of best-effort jobs on gpu-west2a to free up memory.
alex (oncall): Good. Can we route new requests away from that pool while we stabilize?
raman (eng): Initiating routing policy change: `route set --pool gpu-west2a --weight 0 --until 1799457120` (rolling change) — will keep canaries.
raman (eng): Also bumping fallback pool capacity (gpu-warmpool) and enabling cpu-fallback for small requests.
alex (oncall): Running live check: `kubectl logs gpunode-17 -n infra | tail -n 200` -> attaching snippet:
```
E 03:12:18 nvml: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation size=2147483648 pid=2245 model=7b
W 03:12:19 kvcache: evicting prefix 0x7f3a
E 03:12:20 nvml: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation size=1073741824 pid=3311
```
vivian (sre): Noting potential customer impact. Telemetry shows error-rate bump to 6% for generation endpoint in eu-west and us-west for ~3m. Tagging affected customers: cust-omega, cust-lambda.
kelly (support): Notifying account teams and drafting a short status blurb for customers: "We're investigating an elevated error rate impacting generation requests in some regions; mitigation in progress."
alex (oncall): Mitigation steps executed: drained BE jobs, routed new traffic away, increased warmpool. Observed memory pressure decreasing on gpunode-17 from 95% -> 78% in last 60s.
mike (runtime): Adding a temporary limit to KV prefetch on the node: `sysctl set kv_prefetch.max_per_node=8`. This cut prefetch memory use by ~20%.
raman (eng): Rolling a small driver-side gc patch to reduce fragmentation, will ship to canary nodes in 2m.
alex (oncall): Pager duty escalation check — any unresolved escalations?
PagerDuty: No automatic escalations. PD-12345 currently acknowledged by alex (oncall).
vivian (sre): Recommend keeping PD open until fragmentation stable under 60% across pool for 10m. Also prepare a post-incident note: root cause likely kvcache prefetch + large concurrent allocations.
kelly (support): Customer comms sent to account reps (internal thread). I'll update status page after confirmation. :white_check_mark:
mike (runtime): Metrics look good on canary after gc patch, memory fragmentation down ~12%.
alex (oncall): Handing off to night shift: @maria (oncall) — leaving these notes: PD-12345, mitigation applied (drain BE, route change, sysctl tweak, gc patch), affected customers listed, monitor for 10m stability, escalate to raman if memory rises again.
maria (oncall): Acked and taking over. I'll monitor for 30m and call if it reoccurs.
vivian (sre): Adding incident tag `gpu-frag-prefetch` and brief timeline to incident tracker.
alex (oncall): Thanks team. Marking my active involvement complete, leaving handoff. :hand:
